verdict.rationale: The docs index lists an official GLTFLoader, so glTF import is evidenced, but nothing in the pack covers FBX or USD import or shows that any import is clean. Community reports describe real difficulty loading a simple OBJ model, which suggests friction with interchange formats outside glTF. Missing for 10: FBX loader evidence, USD loader evidence, documentation or hands-on proof of clean glTF import fidelity (materials, animations), independent corroboration.
